name: Mailazy
line: Email campaigns and event-triggered messages using your SMTP sender.

cells.api: Yes, REST API; connects an external SMTP sender

subs.math: Estimate from an outside SMTP service: $0.10 per 1,000 emails. The Free plan covers 1,000 contacts and 5,000 emails. 4,000 campaign emails come to about $0.40 a month.
Estimate from an outside SMTP service: $0.10 per 1,000 emails. The Pro plan covers 25,000 contacts. $49 + (20,000 emails at that rate) = $51 a month.
Estimate from an outside SMTP service: $0.10 per 1,000 emails. The Pro plan covers 25,000 contacts. $49 + (40,000 emails at that rate) = $53 a month.
Estimate from an outside SMTP service: $0.10 per 1,000 emails. The Business plan covers unlimited contacts and sends. $199 + (200,000 emails at that rate) = $219 a month.

appmail.math: Estimate from an outside SMTP service: $0.10 per 1,000 emails. 3,000 app emails, one recipient each, to at most 1,000 contacts = $0.30 a month.
Estimate from an outside SMTP service: $0.10 per 1,000 emails. 10,000 app emails, one recipient each. The Pro plan covers up to 25,000 contacts. $49 + $1 at that rate.
Estimate from an outside SMTP service: $0.10 per 1,000 emails. 50,000 app emails, one recipient each. The Pro plan covers up to 25,000 contacts. $49 + $5 at that rate.
Estimate from an outside SMTP service: $0.10 per 1,000 emails. 100,000 emails use the full Pro cap, with at most 25,000 contacts. $49 + $10 at that rate.
